comment: Documented exceptions for the production npm-audit release gate (scripts/audit-gate.cjs). Two shapes: (1) per-GHSA {id,...} allowlists ONE advisory; (2) location-scoped {package, locationContains,...} allowlists ANY advisory for `package` whose EVERY affected install path contains `locationContains` — for a transitive pinned inside an upstream npm-shrinkwrap.json (unfixable downstream), so each new disclosure for that frozen copy need not be re-listed. The 'every node in scope' rule keeps location-scoping precise: it fires only when no remediable copy is affected. Any advisory NOT matched (per-id or location) still fails the gate at moderate+. Every entry must carry reason, clearsWhen, reviewed. Re-verify at every release; the gate warns on stale entries.
